description: Use this to delete a group for everyone in it. expectedRevision is the group's lockVersion from get_group. To only take it off the user's own list, use archive_group or leave_group instead.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

name: delete_group
title: Delete a group
